findings.issue: The legacy word-copy loops of bytes (memory to memory, with the last-word masking) and of long strings into storage slots are printed as whiles (24 of them) instead of copy lines.
findings.rule: A loop `mem[d + i] = mem[s + i]` (or `stor[k + j] = mem[s + 32j]`) over i = 0, 32, ... < n is a copy of ceil32(n) bytes; with the following tail mask it is `mem[d len n] = mem[s len n]` plus a zeroed tail (P7). For storage, print `stor[k len ceil32(n)/32] = mem[s len n]`.
